name: bentley-dm
description: Bentley Development Management - controlled Claude skills for development management, contract administration, quantity surveying and BDM document standards.

plugins.name: bdm-standards
plugins.description: BDM house style and the shared production tooling every BDM deliverable passes through - brand rules, document QA, Word-faithful PDF export and Datum markup. Install this first: every other BDM plugin depends on it.

plugins.name: bdm-contract-admin
plugins.description: Contract administration under AS4000 - variations and CSAs, extensions of time, the Contract Admin Register, progress certificates as Superintendent, tender clarifications and addenda.

plugins.name: bdm-quantity-surveying
plugins.description: Quantity surveying and cost control - floor area schedules and take-offs (Form 405), financier initial and monthly progress valuation reports (Forms 424 / 425), head contract progress claims and the consultant fee register.

plugins.name: bdm-project-delivery
plugins.description: Development and project management delivery - monthly reports to the Principal and to financiers, DA conditions matrices, consultancy agreements, meeting minutes and site inspection records.
